chk.schema_none: Syntax and content are checked as you type; this console does not know this file's schema, so only the server's validator checks its meaning.
chk.text_only: Content (secrets, line endings, invisible characters) is checked as you type; the server's validator checks the rest.
chk.none: No problems found in the draft.
chk.server_never: Not run on this draft yet. Apply always runs it first.

diff.title: Changes against the current file

val.caveat: This validator is only a proxy for the real server, so a pass here does not guarantee the real server will accept the file.
val.caveat_short: Validation for this file is not authoritative: a pass is a hint, not a guarantee.

apply.rollback_ok: Rolled back to the selected revision.

conflict.rediffed: Reloaded the current file. Your edits are kept; review the diff and apply again.

act.note.skillevaluator.evaluate_live: Spends router tokens: an agent runs the skill's eval cases in a sandboxed container for minutes (up to about an hour). It runs in the background; one live run at a time.
pg.title: Send a chat request through this system

se.tiers_hint: Evaluate runs Tier 1 (static checks, plus an LLM judge through the router unless you pick static) and optionally Tier 2 (embedding deduplication, which needs the embeddings model). Tier 3 (live agent runs: the Skill Lift, with the skill minus without it) is the separate Tier 3 action: it runs in a sandboxed runner container through the skillevaluator-local wrapper, takes minutes (up to about an hour), spends router tokens and runs in the background, one at a time. Reports are kept in the console state dir; open one with Evaluate → Show a stored report.
dd.hint: Data Designer is a CLI the console runs on demand: it generates synthetic datasets from a config script through the lab router. The console keeps the run reports and up to the first 2,000 records per run; the full datasets land in ~/Datasets.
dd.scripts_note: Validate and apply execute this script on this machine with your user's privileges (that is how Data Designer loads a config builder). Review it before you run either.
dd.live_line: Create run {name} is running in the background
dd.runs_empty_hint: Run Preview records or Create a dataset; runs are kept in the console state dir (newest 100).
dd.detail_hint: Metadata only. The run directory under the console state dir holds the reports and the dataset files.
dd.records_empty: No records stored for this run.
dd.records_cap: The console keeps at most the first 2,000 records per run (records.jsonl). The parquet files in the run directory always hold the full dataset.
dd.files_empty: No files recorded for this run.
dd.files_hint: The console lists the files but does not serve them; open them on disk.

dyn.preflight_note: Read-only check that runs before every up, down or restart.
dyn.go_dark: Router aliases that go dark while Dynamo holds the card
dyn.lifecycle_hint: Each button runs preflight first and then asks you to confirm the exact effect. These buttons start and stop only Dynamo's containers, with the compose files the running stack was started from (a variant such as Super VL keeps its override file). Dynamo is opt-in: while an exclusive engine holds one of the worker's cards, Up is refused; use the start command shown in the Dynamo status instead.
dyn.effect_up: Starts the Dynamo frontend and worker.
dyn.effect_down: Stops the Dynamo frontend and worker.
dyn.effect_restart: Restarts the Dynamo frontend and worker.
dyn.confirm_refused: Up will be refused while {name} runs on the card: switch with the start command shown in the Dynamo status instead.
dyn.confirm_other_cards: Only Dynamo's containers are started or stopped (plus the one engine below, if you tick it).
dyn.stop_sharing: Also stop {name}, the opt-in engine on this card (required for Up while it runs)
dyn.stop_sharing_hint: Without this, Up is refused. Only that one container is stopped; no other engine is ever stopped from here.
params.title: Tunables

params.effect_live: Writes the compose override. The changed parameters take effect without a restart.
params.confirm_override: The repository compose file is not modified.

err.module: This page's code did not load. If the console was just updated, your browser may still hold older files: reload with Ctrl+Shift+R (Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac).
err.network: Cannot reach the console backend. Check that it is running on 127.0.0.1:8793 and that this page is served from it.
err.401: Authentication is required. Set a bearer token with the key button in the top bar.
err.403: Not allowed. Either your role is viewer, or the request was rejected as cross-origin. Open the console from its own address.

err.415: The server refused the content type. Reload the page to get a matching client.

err.502: The console could not reach the upstream system. Check its status on the Overview page.

dyn.preflight_viewer: Preflight runs a check through the console and is admin-only. Ask an admin to run Up, Down or Restart.
settings.restart_required: A saved change only takes effect after the console backend restarts.
intro.openshell: The sandbox gateway that contains Data Designer runs. It starts on demand, so stopped means off, not down. Its gateway, policy and provider files are read-only here: a web console never loosens a sandbox's trust policy.
intro.dcgm: GPU telemetry from this host's exporter and from the DCGM hosts Prometheus scrapes (loopback only). The counters file is editable; its check is a proxy for the field lists in the exporter image.
intro.aiperf: Load profiles against a live engine through the router. A profile run spends router capacity and takes minutes, so it asks for confirmation; one run at a time.
intro.guardrails: A NeMo Guardrails server with no internet egress. Rails configs are editable; a candidate is loaded in a network-less container before it is applied, and the server is restarted and checked afterwards.
intro.evaluator: Offline benchmark suites against router aliases. Datasets are fetched once by a human beforehand; runs themselves use no egress. A run spends router tokens and takes minutes.
gen.metrics_unavailable: The system reports no metrics right now.
intro.modelopt: Offline compression of a pinned checkpoint: quantization, REAP expert pruning or Minitron. A job takes a GPU for hours and writes a new checkpoint, so it asks for confirmation; the job runs in the background and the console reads its result.
intro.gym: Reinforcement-learning environments and rollouts, run contained: each Gym command runs in a client container on an internal network whose only way out is a router broker. A smoke run rolls out a few scored tasks through the router, so it spends tokens on a shared engine and asks first; it runs in the background and the console keeps only the numbers.
intro.flare: NVIDIA's research-prototype inference server (Rust), on sm120 GPUs (RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090) and sm121 GPUs (one DGX Spark, or several as one engine). It serves a package prepared once per GPU family and tensor-parallel size, on that family. Every action goes through the lab launcher, which defines the targets, refuses to start unless a target's GPUs are free and never stops another engine. An experiment lane, off by default; the version shown is the pinned upstream commit.
